title: SLGO top-right killfeed payload (hud.killfeed)
description: The viewer's killfeed (CS2 HudDeathNotice), oldest first. One recipient per publish; sent only to clients declaring hud-killfeed. Times are remaining milliseconds at the envelope's sent_at. Entry ids are unique. A suicide has no assister, no headshot, weapon other, viewer never killer, and its killer is null (no attacker) or the victim themself; any other entry has a killer, and its killer, assister and victim are different players.

suicide.description: CS2 DeathNoticeSuicide: the skull replaces the weapon.

killer.description: null only for a suicide without an attacker (fall, tesla, team change).

viewer.description: The recipient's part in this entry.

visible_remaining_ms.description: Time left before the entry starts fading out: 5 s, 7.5 s when the viewer is the killer or the victim.

team.description: Side at the time of the death; null when unassigned.
